'''Tim Guzman''' was a Las Vegas tournament director and a Decipher-era [[Squadron Members|Squadron Member]], Gold 117.<ref name="decsq-prof" /><ref name="sm-fan" />

He began directing after playing in events run by Chris Hines (Gold 8), and joined the squadron on Hines's recommendation.<ref name="decsq-prof" />

Decipher recruited volunteer Squadron Members in the 1990s to promote SWCCG locally (tournaments, demos, player support).
